paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers went to the town library. It was cloudy, but Leo wore big sunglasses. "Take them off inside," said Teacher Kim with a smile. Leo put the sunglasses in his pocket. Next to the library, there was a building site, and it was very noisy. Leo had to put his hands over his ears. "I am glad that the library is quiet inside," he said.

A woman at the desk told the club about the library. "We have three departments," she said. "The children's department is downstairs." "The student department is upstairs." "The history department is on the top floor." Lily needed a book about the old town, so she went to the history department. Teacher Kim and Mia went with her, but Leo and May stayed downstairs.

Lily climbed the stairs to the top floor. It was quiet and cool there. There were many old books on the top shelf, and every book had a different cover. She found a thin book with a red cover. It had a map of the old town on the first page. "This is perfect for our blog," she said. "Good," said Teacher Kim, "and now we can borrow it."

Downstairs, Leo read a comic about a dog in space. He took his sunglasses out of his pocket and put them on a shelf among the comics. Then he forgot them. When it was time to go, Leo could not find his sunglasses. "Where are they?" he asked. May and Leo looked among the comics and under the chairs, but they found nothing. Then a student came down the stairs. He was a boy of about sixteen, and he held the sunglasses in his hand. "Are these yours?" he asked. "Yes, thank you!" said Leo. He was very happy.

At the desk, the woman said, "You can borrow five books." "But you must return them in two weeks." Lily took the red book, and Mia took a book about monkeys. Outside, the clouds were gone. The sun was hot. Leo put on his sunglasses. "Now I need them," he said, "and now Teacher Kim cannot say no!" Teacher Kim laughed, and the noisy building site did not matter.
